properties.text: THE SOROBAN CALCULATOR -- the pocket calculator of calculator.json, with its display counted out in beads.  Click the keys: the Keypad sends one message per key press, the Calculator Engine keeps the sum and emits the whole display on every key, and both the seven-segment readout and the Figure follow it digit by digit.  The Figure is a Japanese soroban.  Each rod holds one digit: the heaven bead above the beam is worth 5, each of the four earth beads below it is worth 1, and a bead counts when it touches the beam -- so 7 is the heaven bead down and two earth beads up.  The UNIT ROD (the blue marker) is fixed: ten rods of whole number end on it, five rods of decimals follow.  The white dots on the beam mark it and every third rod from it, the way a real soroban marks thousands.  What the beads cannot show: a sign (a negative result gets a red note instead), decimals past the fifth (1 / 3 is 0.33333 on the frame) and an error -- the engine sends only 0 when it latches, so after a division by zero the frame simply clears; press C.

properties.program:
# THE SOROBAN -- the calculator's display, counted in beads
#
# `x` is whatever the Calculator Engine shows.  Fifteen rods, one digit
# each: the heaven bead above the beam is worth 5, each of the four
# earth beads below it is worth 1, and a bead counts when it touches the
# beam.  The UNIT ROD is fixed -- ten rods of whole number to its left
# and itself, five of decimals to its right -- and the white dots on the
# beam mark it and every third rod from it, as on a real soroban.

# every digit on the frame, the decimals included, as one whole number
N    = round(abs(x) * 100000)
neg  = x < 0
big  = abs(x) >= 10000000000

view -66, -49.5, 66, 49.5

# --- the frame ---------------------------------------------------------------
color "#2a1a10"
width 0.5
with fill "#5a3a24"
  rect -63, 33, 126, 3.5
  rect -63, -24.5, 126, 3.5
  rect -63, -24.5, 3, 61
  rect 60, -24.5, 3, 61
end
rect -60, 16, 120, 2  with fill "#c9a877"

# --- a bead: dark when it counts, pale when it does not ---------------------
def bead x, y, on
  fill 0.82 - 0.27 * on, 0.64 - 0.40 * on, 0.42 - 0.28 * on
  poly x - 3.6, y, x - 1.5, y + 2.5, x + 1.5, y + 2.5,
       x + 3.6, y, x + 1.5, y - 2.5, x - 1.5, y - 2.5
end

# the four earth beads of a rod, worth one each: bead i (0 at the bottom) is
# pushed up to the beam when it is one of the top n that count
def earth x, n
  repeat 4
    on = i >= 4 - n
    bead x, -18.5 + 5 * i + 17 * on, on
  end
end

# --- each rod: its line, the beam's dot, its digit and its beads ------------------
align "centre", "middle"
font 4.6
# the beads' outline; the rods and the dots carry their own widths
width 0.35
repeat 15
  rx = -56 + 8 * i
  line rx, -21, rx, 33  with color "#6b5a48", width 0.7
  # a dot on the unit rod and on every third rod from it
  if (9 - i) % 3 == 0
    point rx, 17  with color "#f4efe6", width 1.1
  end
  # the digit this rod holds; a leading zero is drawn faint
  d    = floor(N / pow(10, 14 - i)) % 10
  lead = (i < 9) * (N < pow(10, 14 - i))
  g    = 0.2 + 0.55 * lead
  text rx, -29, "%.0f", d  with color g, g, g
  # the heaven bead, worth five, comes down on the beam when it counts
  h = floor(d / 5)
  bead rx, 30.5 - 10 * h, h
  # the earth beads hold what is left over
  earth rx, d % 5
end
# the decimal point in the digit row, just after the unit rod
point 20, -31  with color "#202020", width 1

# --- the unit rod's marker -----------------------------------------------------
color "#2e6b8b"
poly 12, 41, 16, 37.5, 20, 41  with fill "#2e6b8b"
font 3.6
align "left", "middle"
text 21.5, 40, "unit rod"

# ========================================================================
#  THE READOUT
# ========================================================================
color "#202020"
font 6
text -63, 42, "The soroban"
text 63, -37, "%.12g", x  with color "#8a3a1e", font 4.8, align "right", "middle"
text -63, -37, "above the beam 5, below it 1"  with color "#606060", font 3.8
color "#b03a2e"
font 4.2
if neg
  text -63, -42.5, "negative: a soroban has no sign, read the beads as minus"
end
if big
  text -63, -42.5 - 5 * neg, "too big: only the last ten whole digits are on the frame"
end
